name: @rentnerkev/tooltips
description: A lightweight, customizable React tooltip component powered by Radix UI.
author: RentnerKev

scripts.build: bun -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src playground/src playground/vite.config.ts scripts playwright.config.ts .github
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix --deny-warnings src playground/src playground/vite.config.ts scripts playwright.config.ts .github
scripts.format: oxfmt src playground/src playground/package.json playground/tsconfig.json playground/vite.config.ts scripts playwright.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json tailwind.css README.md docs .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json bunfig.toml .github
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src playground/src playground/package.json playground/tsconfig.json playground/vite.config.ts scripts playwright.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json tailwind.css README.md docs .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json bunfig.toml .github
scripts.verify: bun run playground:install && bun run typecheck && bun run playground:typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test && bun run build && bun run playground:build && bun run test:browser && bun run pack:check && bun run pack:consumer
